subject: Premium offset ask: approval for renewal concessions (D-93821)
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@northbridge.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.io, Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@northbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal — need flexibility on pricing/SLA

Stephanie,

We appreciate Redwood's partnership — our renewal with Redwood (D-93821) is up next month. Usage has exceeded our forecast due to a new product line and that has put pressure on our budget committee. Procurement is asking for a path forward that reduces near-term spend and adds a little more operational protection on latency for our critical endpoints.

Concretely, our asks are:
- 15% list discount for the first 6 months of the renewal term
- A one-time usage credit to offset the unexpected spike (~$35–50k range)
- SLA uplift for the critical inference route (99.95% and a 30ms soft latency buffer for 12 months)

Can Redwood confirm whether you can make a limited-time concession here and I can pull procurement through for signature. We need answers quickly to avoid losing budget window this quarter.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Platform
NorthBridge Analytics
[attachment: NorthBridge_Q3_usage_summary.csv]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@northbridge.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — need flexibility on pricing/SLA

Samir — thanks for laying this out and for the usage file. Appreciate the urgency.

I'll run a short internal review with Deal Desk and Sales Ops. Rishi, Vivek — looped you in for visibility; can you advise on precedent and margin tolerance for a short-term discount + credit + SLA uplift? I want to return with a single consolidated proposal that aligns to our rules (and flags anything legal needs).

Samir — can you confirm the expected renewal term length you want (12 vs 24 months) and whether the SLA apply to 1 or 2 inference endpoints? That affects the cost model.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Mobile: +1-415-555-0164

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal — need flexibility on pricing/SLA

Putting numbers on the table for an executive decision. Based on their Q3 overage and the ask:
- Option A (12-month renewal, retention-first): 15% list discount for months 1–6, then revert to standard pricing; one-time usage credit of $40,000; SLA uplift to 99.95% + an operational playbook (30ms buffer on 2 critical inference routes) for 12 months. Expected margin hit ~28% for the initial period.
- Option B (24-month renewal, deeper commit): 12% discount first 12 months, $25k credit, SLA uplift for 12 months — margin hit ~18% but longer term ARR locked.

Key concerns: precedent (we've done credits but not SLA latency buffers broadly), engineering capacity to support the latency buffer on short notice, and legal's requirement for a firm makegood clause if we fail the SLA.

If we proceed, we need Vivek or a revenue exec to sign off on Option A (higher short-term cost) and authorize Legal to carve the SOW accordingly. Laura — CS ops will need to own the 30-day runbook and monitoring changes.

Rishi
Deal Desk Manager
[internal calc attached: margin_impact_D-93821.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal — need flexibility on pricing/SLA

Thanks Rishi. Quick thoughts:
- Option A looks like the faster path to keep them; I want to see the expected 12-month churn risk reduction to justify the 28% hit. Can Sales Ops quantify expected retention delta?
- We should only approve Option A if Legal can include a limited makegood (credit cap) and the 30ms buffer is scoped to the two named endpoints. No open-ended operational commitments.
- Laura — if CS can absorb the operationalization for 12 months (runbook + monitoring + 1x dedicated on-call escalation), I'm prepared to approve Option A conditionally. Need final numbers by COB Thurs so we can lock the quarter.

Vivek
SVP Sales Operations

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Executive summary for approval — NorthBridge (D-93821)

Vivek/Laura — consolidated ask below for exec signoff and to instruct Legal/CS to prepare SOW addendum:

Customer: NorthBridge Analytics (renewal due 11/15)
Deal: D-93821; annualized ARR at renewal $1.1M
Recommended concession (Option A):
- 15% list discount for months 1–6
- One-time usage credit: $40,000
- SLA uplift: 99.95% uptime + 30ms soft latency buffer for 2 critical inference endpoints for 12 months

Rationale: immediate retention risk due to Q3 usage spike; procurement will approve if we show short-term cost relief + operational commitments. We believe the concession will preserve ~$1.0M ARR vs. potential churn.

Operational asks if approved:
- Legal: prepare limited makegood clause and SOW addendum (cap credit to $40k; specify endpoints).
- CS Ops (Laura): prepare runbook, monitoring dashboard, and 1x named on-call for incident escalation.
- Revenue Ops: confirm expected retention delta metric (we estimate 70% likelihood of renewal if concession approved).

Attachments: draft SOW (SOW_NorthBridge_v3.pdf), risk assessment (NorthBridge_Risk_Assessment.xlsx)

Approval requested: Vivek to approve Option A and authorize Legal to prepare the DocuSign package. Laura to confirm operational readiness.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
[attachment: SOW_NorthBridge_v3.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive summary for approval — NorthBridge (D-93821)

Approved, on the following conditions:
- Approve Option A (15% for first 6 months + $40k credit + SLA uplift) with a hard cap on total concession cost and a makegood clause limiting credit to $40k.
- Term: 12 months. After 12 months, revert to standard pricing unless they sign a 24-month commit.
- Legal to prepare a DocuSign SOW addendum (link below). Please ensure the SLA terms are scoped to the two endpoints and that the runbook includes an agreed remediation timeline.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/D-93821-SOW
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/93821

Laura — you confirm CS ops can deliver the runbook and 1x dedicated on-call within 10 business days? If yes, instruct Legal to send the package to procurement for signature.

Vivek
SVP Sales Operations
